title: The morning after the news
why: Lakshman is ready to fight over the exile. Ram asks him to put the anger down and help pack for the forest.
todo: Today, notice one flash of anger and let it pass before you answer.

verse.sa: निगृह्य रोषं शोकं च धैर्यमाश्रित्य केवलम्
verse.iast: nigṛhya roṣaṃ śokaṃ ca dhairyamāśritya kevalam

meaning.en: Hold back your anger and your grief, and lean on steadiness alone.
meaning.hi: गुस्से और दुख, दोनों को थामो, और सिर्फ़ धीरज का सहारा लो।

title: What Ram told Bharata
why: At Chitrakoot, Bharata begs Ram to come home. Ram answers with this line about everything that comes together and parts.
todo: Call someone you have drifted from. People part; reach out while you can.

verse.sa: सर्वे क्षयान्ता निचयाः पतनान्ताः समुच्छ्रयाः। संयोगा विप्रयोगान्ता मरणान्तं च जीवितम्॥
verse.iast: sarve kṣayāntā nicayāḥ patanāntāḥ samucchrayāḥ | saṃyogā viprayogāntā maraṇāntaṃ ca jīvitam

meaning.en: Whatever is gathered runs out, whatever rises falls, whatever comes together parts, and every life ends in death.
meaning.hi: जो जुटता है वह चुकता है, जो उठता है वह गिरता है, जो मिलते हैं वे बिछड़ते हैं, और हर जीवन का अंत मृत्यु है।

title: When the worst has happened
why: Sita is gone and Ram is ready to burn the world down. His younger brother steadies him with this.
todo: Name the trouble you are in. Then remember one hard time you came through.

verse.sa: आश्वसिहि नरश्रेष्ठ प्राणिनः कस्य नापदः। संस्पृशन्त्यग्निवद् राजन् क्षणेन व्यपयान्ति च॥
verse.iast: āśvasihi naraśreṣṭha prāṇinaḥ kasya nāpadaḥ | saṃspṛśantyagnivad rājan kṣaṇena vyapayānti ca

meaning.en: Take heart, best of men. Trouble comes to every living being. It catches like fire, and in a moment it passes.
meaning.hi: धीरज रखिए, नरश्रेष्ठ। किस पर विपत्ति नहीं आती? वह आग की तरह छूती है और पल भर में चली जाती है।

title: Before Part 2
why: Part 2 brings Hanuman to Lanka. He searches the whole city, finds nothing, nearly gives up, and then says this to himself.
todo: Go back to one thing you gave up on this year and give it one more hour.
bridge: From tomorrow the plan hands over to the Bhagavad Gita: three verses where Krishna tells Arjuna what these four lines have been saying.

verse.sa: अनिर्वेदः श्रियो मूलमनिर्वेदः परं सुखम्। भूयस्तत्र विचेष्यामि न यत्र विचयः कृतः॥
verse.iast: anirvedaḥ śriyo mūlamanirvedaḥ paraṃ sukham | bhūyastatra viceṣyāmi na yatra vicayaḥ kṛtaḥ

speaker.hi: हनुमान, लंका में मन ही मन

meaning.en: Not losing heart is the root of good fortune and the highest happiness. I will search again where I have not yet searched.
meaning.hi: हिम्मत न हारना ही सफलता की जड़ है, यही सबसे बड़ा सुख है। जहाँ अब तक नहीं ढूँढा, वहाँ फिर ढूँढूँगा।

title: It came, and it will go
why: Days 2 and 3 said that trouble comes and passes. Krishna tells Arjuna the same about heat and cold, pleasure and pain: they come and go, so bear them.
todo: When something stings today, tell yourself: this came, and it will go.

verse.iast: mātrāsparśās tu kaunteya śītoṣṇasukhaduḥkhadāḥ | āgamāpāyino 'nityās tāṃs titikṣasva bhārata ||

meaning.en: Heat and cold, pleasure and pain come and go through the senses. They don't last. Bear them patiently.
meaning.hi: सर्दी गर्मी, सुख दुःख इंद्रियों से आते जाते हैं। ये टिकते नहीं, इन्हें धीरज से सह लो।

title: Lift yourself
why: Hanuman talked himself out of despair. Krishna says your own mind can be your friend or your enemy, so lift yourself up by yourself.
todo: Write down one thing you will do for yourself today, then do it.

verse.sa: उद्धरेदात्मनाऽऽत्मानं नात्मानमवसादयेत् । आत्मैव ह्यात्मनो बन्धुरात्मैव रिपुरात्मनः ॥
verse.iast: uddhared ātmanātmānaṃ nātmānam avasādayet | ātmaiva hy ātmano bandhur ātmaiva ripur ātmanaḥ ||

meaning.en: Lift yourself by your own effort, and never pull yourself down. You are your own friend, and your own enemy.
meaning.hi: खुद को खुद ऊपर उठाओ, कभी नीचे मत गिराओ। तुम ही अपने मित्र हो, तुम ही अपने शत्रु।

title: Your part
why: Jatayu fought knowing he could lose. Krishna tells Arjuna that the work is his and the result never was.
todo: Pick the task you have avoided because of how it might turn out, and do your part today.

verse.sa: कर्मण्येवाधिकारस्ते मा फलेषु कदाचन । मा कर्मफलहेतुर्भूर्मा ते सङ्गोऽस्त्वकर्मणि ॥
verse.iast: karmaṇy evādhikāras te mā phaleṣu kadācana | mā karmaphalahetur bhūr mā te saṅgo 'stv akarmaṇi ||

meaning.en: Your right is to the work, never its fruits. Don't make the fruit your motive, or cling to inaction.
meaning.hi: कर्म करना तुम्हारे हाथ में है, फल कभी नहीं। फल की चाह से कर्म न करो, न अकर्म से मोह।
